clues.text: While shepherding Jethro's flock at Horeb, the mountain of God, Moses came upon this marvelous sight.
The angel of the LORD appeared to Moses in blazing fire from within it, yet it was not consumed.
God called out "Moses, Moses!" from within it, and Moses answered, "Here I am."
When Moses went over to look at it, God told him to take off his sandals on holy ground.
In his blessing on Joseph's land, Moses asked for the favor of Him who dwelt in this.
Asked whose wife a woman married to seven brothers would be when the dead rise, Jesus pointed to the passage about this.
Stephen said Moses, once rejected as ruler and judge, was sent as redeemer through the angel who appeared in it.
